name: roycss
description: Machine-readable class grammar for the RoyCSS effects framework, derived from the live catalog (1,959 effects / 29 categories).

classNamePattern.description: One class namespace: roycss- + lowercase kebab-case effect id. Digits allowed (catalog ids may start with a digit).
classNamePattern.roundTrip: validated against all 1,977 real class names at generation time

modifiers.description: No class in the stylesheet contains '--'. There are no --lg/--sm style variants; customize via the effect's own CSS/custom properties.

auxiliaryClassNote: 17 selectors that only appear inside their parent effect's own CSS/marker markup — not standalone utilities.

namingFamilies.description: Curated id sub-families present in the catalog (computed).

forbidden.note: Each entry is a documented failure mode (docs-vs-package drift, audit F-01/F-02). See roycss.training-pairs.jsonl anti-pairs.
